title: Nourishing Creamy Polish Mushroom Pierogi
description: A pungent and creamy Polish dish featuring thyme and mushrooms, wrapped in pandan leaves for a romantic touch. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat and saute onion and garlic until softened.
Add mushrooms and thyme to the skillet and cook until the mushrooms release their liquid and start to brown.
Deglaze the skillet with a little water and stir to loosen the fond.
In a large bowl, combine cooked potato, sour cream, and mushroom mixture, and mix well.
Add flour, egg, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk and place a tablespoon of the mushroom mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Wrap each pierogi in a pandan leaf and steam for 10 minutes.
Serve the pierogi hot with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of thyme.
